```{r}
insect_counts<-read_csv("data/insect_counts.csv")
flower_counts<-read_csv("data/flower_counts.csv")
site_df<-read_csv("data/site_metadata.csv")
site_count <- nrow(site_df)
print(site_count)
total_insect_obs <- insect_counts |>
  pull(n_observed) |>
  sum()
print(total_insect_obs)
by_observation<-insect_counts|>arrange(desc(n_observed))
gt(by_observation)
```

```{r}
H_tumulorum<-insect_counts|>filter(species=="Halictus tumulorum")|>mutate(detected=n_observed>0)
ht_df<-inner_join(H_tumulorum,site_df)
write_csv(ht_df, "output/ht_df.csv")

```

```{r}
ht_temp_df <- ht_df |>
  select(x1km_square, detected, min_temp_coldest_month)
gt(head(ht_temp_df))
ht_temp_summ <- ht_temp_df |>
  group_by(detected) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(min_temp_coldest_month),
    sd = sd(min_temp_coldest_month),
    count = n()
  )

# Separate present and absent sites
present <- ht_temp_summ |>
  filter(detected == TRUE)

absent <- ht_temp_summ |>
  filter(detected == FALSE)

gt(ht_temp_summ)
gt(present)
gt(absent)
```

```{r}
ttest_ht_temp<-t.test(min_temp_coldest_month ~ detected,data = ht_temp_df, var.equal = TRUE)
print(ttest_ht_temp)
```

```{r}
lm_ht<-lm(min_temp_coldest_month ~ detected,data = ht_temp_df)
summ_lm_ht<-summary(lm_ht)
print(summ_lm_ht)
```

```{r}
anova_lm <- anova(lm_ht)
anova_lm
#Finished Part 2 of Practical 4
```
